# awscc_glue_data_quality_ruleset (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Glue::DataQualityRuleset



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name for the data quality ruleset.

### Optional

- `client_token` (String) A unique token for idempotency.
- `description` (String) A description of the data quality ruleset.
- `ruleset` (String) A Data Quality Definition Language (DQDL) ruleset.
- `tags` (Map of String) A map of key-value pairs to apply to this resource.
- `target_table` (Attributes) An object representing an AWS Glue table. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_table))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--target_table"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_table`

Optional:

- `database_name` (String) The name of the database where the AWS Glue table exists.
- `table_name` (String) The name of the AWS Glue table.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_glue_data_quality_ruleset.example
  identity = {
    name = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) A unique name for the data quality ruleset

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform

  to = awscc_glue_data_quality_ruleset.example
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
